records.title: Support for Electric bus fleet expansion in Telangana.
details:
a: Yes, the Government has received a proposal form Telangana for the deployment of 2,800 electric buses under the PM E-DRIVE Scheme.
b to c: The State of Telangana has conveyed its intent to explore a Hybrid GCC model. However, currently, the model is not being considered under the current framework of PM E-DRIVE Scheme.
